I had to cancel a work meeting, and honestly just sitting in that imaging center in the afternoon when I was already irritated about the wait—it was not a good experience. Two weeks just to get a slot felt ridiculous.

That's reassuring news—minor cartilage wear but no surgery needed. So the follow-up with Dr. Liang was around March 28th or 29th, and his recommendation was physical therapy for knee strengthening and stability.
